evidence: Running the minimal BoxCOCOMetrics repro under tensorflow==2.19.1, keras-cv==0.9.0, and pycocotools==2.0.11 raises InvalidArgumentError: ConcatOp : Dimension 1 in both shapes must be equal: shape[0] = [1,2,4] vs. shape[1] = [1,1,4]. The traceback points to keras_cv/src/metrics/object_detection/box_coco_metrics.py::_box_concat.
steps: Create a BoxCOCOMetrics instance with bounding_box_format='xyxy'.
Call update_state twice with batches whose ground-truth boxes have different per-image counts.
Call result(force=True) and observe the concat failure.
